name: Funnel CRM
description: Funnel CRM is a lightweight sales CRM for growing businesses that turns website enquiries into an organized contact database and sales pipeline. Teams use it to track leads, remember follow-ups, and respond to prospects through their existing email clients or mobile devices.
agentUseSummary: Funnel CRM cannot yet be connected through Relay. Its public product and pricing materials do not publish a first-party developer contract with authentication, endpoints, tenant binding, permissions, limits, token lifecycle, or revocation semantics, so Relay does not infer authority from the signed-in web app or third-party directory claims that an API may exist.

blocked.label: Connect Funnel CRM
blocked.description: Funnel CRM does not publish a first-party application-registration, API-key, OAuth, scope, token, revocation, endpoint, or exact-account binding contract that Relay can implement safely.

blocked.label: Read private CRM data
blocked.description: Contacts, leads, enquiries, pipelines, activities, follow-ups, messages, notes, files, users, and account settings remain unavailable to Relay.

blocked.label: Change CRM records
blocked.description: Creating, updating, assigning, importing, exporting, moving, merging, archiving, or deleting contacts, leads, opportunities, tasks, follow-ups, or other CRM records is blocked.

blocked.label: Send communications
blocked.description: Sending or drafting email, replying to enquiries, changing recipients, creating templates, and initiating any other external communication is blocked.

blocked.label: Use private Funnel CRM interfaces
blocked.description: Browser automation, session cookies, user passwords, traffic inspection, undocumented endpoints, guessed API keys, scraping, arbitrary requests, and third-party directory claims are not an integration contract.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No Funnel CRM action is enabled until the provider supplies a current first-party API contract and Relay approves a bounded account, data, mutation, communication, lifecycle, and rate-limit model.

runtimeSupport.description: No Funnel CRM tools are mounted without a verified first-party API and bounded customer-account contract.

providerSetup.blocker: Funnel CRM's public website and pricing page describe the hosted CRM product and customer subscription, but they do not publish first-party developer documentation, an application-registration process, an API origin or version, endpoints and schemas, API-key or OAuth issuance, scopes or roles, exact customer-account binding, pagination and rate limits, errors, webhooks, token rotation or revocation, disconnect behavior, or third-party automation terms. Software directories that mark the product as offering an API do not supply provider authority or a safe executable contract, and Relay may not inspect the signed-in application or reverse-engineer private traffic.
providerSetup.nextAction: A provider-console owner may contact Funnel CRM or use a representative paid customer only within the separate authorized provider task to obtain the current first-party developer documentation and commercial terms. Product, CRM-data, communications, legal, privacy, security, and customer owners must then freeze credential ownership, exact account or workspace identity, roles, readable fields, search and pagination bounds, supported record mutations, import and export exclusions, communication authority, approval behavior, rate limits, audit, retention, revocation, deletion, and termination before Relay implements typed bounded wrappers and live acceptance.

evidence.supports: Funnel CRM's public product site identifies a hosted CRM for capturing enquiries, maintaining contacts, organizing sales work, and tracking follow-up; the public surface does not expose a developer reference or reusable customer authorization contract.

Funnel CRM publishes customer subscription pricing and self-service product access, but no first-party endpoint, authentication, account-binding, permission, lifecycle, or rate-limit documentation needed to implement an API connector.
Funnel CRM's company profile identifies funnelcrm.co as its website and describes the product as a CRM for growing businesses to manage sales workflows and lead tracking.
